title: Check the deck before you show it
subtitle: Two commands, then your own eyes
bullets: The first loads the deck without a browser: every slide's file, every layout name, every picture and video the slides name
The second opens every slide and step in a hidden browser, takes a screenshot of each, and lists text that overflows, a title that wraps, media that did not load
It prints the path of a contact sheet. Open it: a clean report does not show a slide that is legible but wrong
task: Run these two commands in a terminal, at the top folder of the repository. A deck in `presentations` is named by its id in place of `./tutorial`. This task cannot tick itself.
snippet:
npm run check -- ./tutorial
npm run capture -- ./tutorial
ask: Validate the slides of the tutorial deck.
